article.title: Computation of time mentioned in instruments.
article.content: All instruments shall for the purposes of this Act be deemed to be made with reference to the Gregorian calendar.
article.html:
24Computation of time mentioned in instruments.

Section 24 · Part III, Computation of Period of Limitation

All instruments shall for the purposes of this Act be deemed to be made with reference to the Gregorian calendar.
